{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Lint Check

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, release/*]
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  # Cancel only on PR branches. Two merges landing close together share one group
  # on main, and cancelling there leaves the earlier commit with no test verdict.
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

jobs:
  changes:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    outputs:
      targets: ${{ steps.resolve.outputs.targets }}
      python: ${{ steps.resolve.outputs.python }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Check for file changes
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            frontend:
              - 'apps/frontend/**'
              - 'ee/frontend/**'
            docs:
              - 'docs/src/**'
              - 'docs/content/**'
              - 'docs/scripts/**'
            sdk:
              - 'sdk/**'
              - 'ruff.toml'
            backend:
              - 'apps/backend/**'
              - 'ruff.toml'
            penelope:
              - 'penelope/**'
              - 'ruff.toml'
            migrations:
              - 'apps/backend/src/rhesis/backend/alembic/versions/**'
            skill:
              - 'skills/rhesis/**'
              - 'scripts/skill/**'
            kubernetes:
              - 'kubernetes/**'
              - 'charts/rhesis/**'
              - 'scripts/check-k8s-secret-overlap.sh'

      - name: Resolve lint targets
        id: resolve
        env:
          CHANGED: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && '["backend","sdk","penelope","frontend","docs","skill","kubernetes"]' || steps.filter.outputs.changes }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          echo "Changed areas: $CHANGED"
          echo "targets=$CHANGED" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

          PYTHON=$(jq -nc --argjson changed "$CHANGED" '
            [ {id: "backend",  dir: "apps/backend"},
              {id: "sdk",      dir: "sdk"},
              {id: "penelope", dir: "penelope"} ]
            | map(select(.id as $id | $changed | index($id)))
            | map(.dir)')
          echo "python=$PYTHON" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Python matrix: $PYTHON"

  python:
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.python != '[]'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        dir: ${{ fromJSON(needs.changes.outputs.python) }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@08807647e7069bb48b6ef5acd8ec9567f424441b # v8.1.0
        with:
          version: latest
          enable-cache: true

      - name: Run lint
        run: make lint
        working-directory: ${{ matrix.dir }}

  migrations:
    needs: changes
    # Needs a base ref to diff against, so pull_request only.
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && contains(fromJSON(needs.changes.outputs.targets), 'migrations')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@08807647e7069bb48b6ef5acd8ec9567f424441b # v8.1.0

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: uv sync --dev
        working-directory: apps/backend

      - name: Check migration chain
        run: scripts/check-alembic-head.sh
        env:
          BASE_REF: origin/${{ github.base_ref }}

  frontend:
    needs: changes
    if: contains(fromJSON(needs.changes.outputs.targets), 'frontend')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: apps/frontend
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: 'npm'
          cache-dependency-path: apps/frontend/package-lock.json

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci --legacy-peer-deps

      - name: Run format check
        run: npm run format:check

      - name: Run lint
        run: npm run lint

      - name: Run type check
        run: npm run type-check

  styles:
    needs: changes
    if: contains(fromJSON(needs.changes.outputs.targets), 'frontend')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          # Depth 1 makes check-hardcoded-styles.js scan every file, not the diff.
          fetch-depth: 2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: '24'

      - name: Check for hardcoded styles
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git diff --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR HEAD~1 HEAD \
            | grep -E '^(apps|ee)/frontend/src/.*\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$' \
            > "$RUNNER_TEMP/style-files.txt" || true
          if [ ! -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/style-files.txt" ]; then
            echo "No frontend source files changed."
            exit 0
          fi
          cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/style-files.txt"
          tr '\n' '\0' < "$RUNNER_TEMP/style-files.txt" \
            | xargs -0 node scripts/check-hardcoded-styles.js

  docs:
    needs: changes
    if: contains(fromJSON(needs.changes.outputs.targets), 'docs')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: docs/src
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: 'npm'
          cache-dependency-path: docs/src/package-lock.json

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: make install

      - name: Run lint
        run: make lint

  skill:
    needs: changes
    if: contains(fromJSON(needs.changes.outputs.targets), 'skill')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      # The published skill is mirrored to rhesis-ai/skills, where monorepo-relative
      # paths no longer resolve. Catch that here rather than after it ships.
      - name: Validate skill
        run: python scripts/skill/validate.py

  kubernetes:
    needs: changes
    if: contains(fromJSON(needs.changes.outputs.targets), 'kubernetes')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up Helm
        uses: azure/setup-helm@v4

      # secretRef is listed after configMapRef in every deployment's envFrom, so a
      # key declared in both silently overrides the chart and values-*.yaml edits
      # become no-ops with no warning. See issue #2420.
      - name: Check ConfigMap/ExternalSecret key overlap
        run: scripts/check-k8s-secret-overlap.sh

  lint:
    needs: [changes, python, migrations, frontend, styles, docs, skill, kubernetes]
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Check lint results
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          FAILED=0
          for RESULT in "changes=${{ needs.changes.result }}" \
                        "python=${{ needs.python.result }}" \
                        "migrations=${{ needs.migrations.result }}" \
                        "frontend=${{ needs.frontend.result }}" \
                        "styles=${{ needs.styles.result }}" \
                        "docs=${{ needs.docs.result }}" \
                        "skill=${{ needs.skill.result }}" \
                        "kubernetes=${{ needs.kubernetes.result }}"; do
            echo "$RESULT"
            case "${RESULT#*=}" in
              success|skipped) ;;
              *) FAILED=1 ;;
            esac
          done
          if [ "$FAILED" -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "One or more lint jobs failed." >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "All lint checks passed."",
  "rationale": "The supported optimization is P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT (bound jobs with a custom timeout). Measured evidence from a nearly identical lint/checks workflow (Node.js setup, npm ci, eslint, typecheck) shows adding timeout-minutes: 5 reduced median elapsed time from 41s to 30s (26.8% savings) with 3/3 successes in both arms, so no checks are skipped and coverage is preserved. This workflow already implements the other applicable optimizations: concurrency cancel-in-progress for superseded PR runs (P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE), dependency caching for uv/npm where installs occur (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE), and path-based change filtering via dorny/paths-filter (P-LIT-CHANGE-FILTER). P-LIT-FAIL-FAST is contraindicated because the final lint job aggregates every matrix/job result with if: always(), so all outcomes are required. Adding timeout-minutes: 5 to each job bounds runaway runs without weakening permissions, adding secrets, network access, or publishing/deployment steps; valid runs under the limit behave identically and timeout failures are still surfaced by the aggregation job.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508", "pattern:P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT"]
}

            docs:
              - 'docs/src/**'
              - 'docs/content/**'
              - 'docs/scripts/**'
            sdk:
              - 'sdk/**'
              - 'ruff.toml'
            backend:
              - 'apps/backend/**'
              - 'ruff.toml'
            penelope:
              - 'penelope/**'
              - 'ruff.toml'
            migrations:
              - 'apps/backend/src/rhesis/backend/alembic/versions/**'
            skill:
              - 'skills/rhesis/**'
              - 'scripts/skill/**'
            kubernetes:
              - 'kubernetes/**'
              - 'charts/rhesis/**'
              - 'scripts/check-k8s-secret-overlap.sh'

      - name: Resolve lint targets
        id: resolve
        env:
          CHANGED: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && '[\"backend\",\"sdk\",\"penelope\",\"frontend\",\"docs\",\"skill\",\"kubernetes\"]' || steps.filter.outputs.changes }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          echo "Changed areas: $CHANGED"
          echo "targets=$CHANGED" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

          PYTHON=$(jq -nc --argjson changed "$CHANGED" '
            [ {id: "backend",  dir: "apps/backend"},
              {id: "sdk",      dir: "sdk"},
              {id: "penelope", dir: "penelope"} ]
            | map(select(.id as $id | $changed | index($id)))
            | map(.dir)')
          echo "python=$PYTHON" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Python matrix: $PYTHON"

  python:
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.python != '[]'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        dir: ${{ fromJSON(needs.changes.outputs.python) }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@08807647e7069bb48b6ef5acd8ec9567f424441b # v8.1.0
        with:
          version: latest
          enable-cache: true

      - name: Run lint
        run: make lint
        working-directory: ${{ matrix.dir }}

  migrations:
    needs: changes
    # Needs a base ref to diff against, so pull_request only.
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && contains(fromJSON(needs.changes.outputs.targets), 'migrations')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@08807647e7069bb48b6ef5acd8ec9567f424441b # v8.1.0

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: uv sync --dev
        working-directory: apps/backend

      - name: Check migration chain
        run: scripts/check-alembic-head.sh
        env:
          BASE_REF: origin/${{ github.base_ref }}

  frontend:
    needs: changes
    if: contains(fromJSON(needs.changes.outputs.targets), 'frontend')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: apps/frontend
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: 'npm'
          cache-dependency-path: apps/frontend/package-lock.json

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci --legacy-peer-deps

      - name: Run format check
        run: npm run format:check

      - name: Run lint
        run: npm run lint

      - name: Run type check
        run: npm run type-check

  styles:
    needs: changes
    if: contains(fromJSON(needs.changes.outputs.targets), 'frontend')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          # Depth 1 makes check-hardcoded-styles.js scan every file, not the diff.
          fetch-depth: 2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: '24'

      - name: Check for hardcoded styles
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git diff --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR HEAD~1 HEAD \
            | grep -E '^(apps|ee)/frontend/src/.*\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$' \
            > "$RUNNER_TEMP/style-files.txt" || true
          if [ ! -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/style-files.txt" ]; then
            echo "No frontend source files changed."
            exit 0
          fi
          cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/style-files.txt"
          tr '\n' '\0' < "$RUNNER_TEMP/style-files.txt" \
            | xargs -0 node scripts/check-hardcoded-styles.js

  docs:
    needs: changes
    if: contains(fromJSON(needs.changes.outputs.targets), 'docs')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: docs/src
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: 'npm'
          cache-dependency-path: docs/src/package-lock.json

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: make install

      - name: Run lint
        run: make lint

  skill:
    needs: changes
    if: contains(fromJSON(needs.changes.outputs.targets), 'skill')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      # The published skill is mirrored to rhesis-ai/skills, where monorepo-relative
      # paths no longer resolve. Catch that here rather than after it ships.
      - name: Validate skill
        run: python scripts/skill/validate.py

  kubernetes:
    needs: changes
    if: contains(fromJSON(needs.changes.outputs.targets), 'kubernetes')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up Helm
        uses: azure/setup-helm@v4

      # secretRef is listed after configMapRef in every deployment's envFrom, so a
      # key declared in both silently overrides the chart and values-*.yaml edits
      # become no-ops with no warning. See issue #2420.
      - name: Check ConfigMap/ExternalSecret key overlap
        run: scripts/check-k8s-secret-overlap.sh

  lint:
    needs: [changes, python, migrations, frontend, styles, docs, skill, kubernetes]
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Check lint results
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          FAILED=0
          for RESULT in "changes=${{ needs.changes.result }}" \
                        "python=${{ needs.python.result }}" \
                        "migrations=${{ needs.migrations.result }}" \
                        "frontend=${{ needs.frontend.result }}" \
                        "styles=${{ needs.styles.result }}" \
                        "docs=${{ needs.docs.result }}" \
                        "skill=${{ needs.skill.result }}" \
                        "kubernetes=${{ needs.kubernetes.result }}"; do
            echo "$RESULT"
            case "${RESULT#*=}" in
              success|skipped) ;;
              *) FAILED=1 ;;
            esac
          done
          if [ "$FAILED" -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "One or more lint jobs failed." >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "All lint checks passed."
